summary: Enterprise AI model API aggregators let corporations consume foundation models (GPT, Claude, Llama, Gemini, Mistral, and more) through a secure, managed API without data leaving their governed cloud environment. In 2026 the market is led by the three hyperscalers (AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI/Foundry, and Google Vertex AI Model Garden), with data-platform-native options (Snowflake Cortex, Databricks) and governance-focused platforms (IBM watsonx) gaining ground. There is no single winner — fit depends on existing cloud footprint, required model breadth, compliance needs, and where your data already lives.
why_enterprises_use_aggregators: Data residency and privacy: prompts, embeddings, and fine-tuning data stay inside the company's own cloud tenant/VPC and governed region, rather than being sent to a third-party vendor endpoint.
Compliance and governance: built-in support for SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, FedRAMP, plus audit logging, access controls, and content filtering needed for regulated industries.
Single billing and existing cloud contracts: usage rolls into the enterprise's existing AWS/Azure/GCP agreement and committed spend, simplifying procurement and leveraging negotiated discounts.

Model choice and vendor flexibility: one API gives access to many frontier and open models (Claude, Llama, Mistral, Gemini, GPT, etc.), reducing lock-in to a single model provider and easing model switching.
Enterprise integration and security: native IAM/identity, VPC/private networking, encryption with customer-managed keys, and tight integration with existing data lakes, logging, and DevOps tooling.

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.pricing: On-demand per-token pricing plus Provisioned Throughput (model units) for reserved capacity; batch and prompt-caching discounts available.
key_features: AWS IAM native identity and access control
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already on AWS that want the widest model choice behind one API with strong security and agent/RAG tooling.

platforms.name: Azure OpenAI Service / Azure AI Foundry
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go per-token plus Provisioned Throughput Units (PTUs) for reserved, predictable capacity; batch pricing available.
key_features: Entra ID (Azure AD) identity and RBAC
Azure Monitor diagnostic and audit logs
Content safety filters and responsible AI tooling
Data not used to train base models
platforms.best_for: Microsoft-first enterprises wanting first-party access to OpenAI frontier models within their Azure governance boundary.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI Model Garden
platforms.pricing: Per-token pay-as-you-go plus Provisioned Throughput sold in GSUs (Generative AI Scale Units); e.g., 25 GSUs of Gemini 2.5 Flash ~67,250 tokens/sec sustained.
key_features: VPC Service Controls and Private Service Connect
Grounding with Google Search and RAG engine
platforms.best_for: Google Cloud / data-analytics-heavy enterprises wanting Gemini plus a curated garden of partner and open models.

platforms.name: IBM watsonx.ai
platforms.pricing: Resource-unit / per-token consumption pricing; available as SaaS, dedicated, and on-premises/hybrid (Cloud Pak for Data).
key_features: watsonx.governance for model risk, audit, and compliance tracking
watsonx Orchestrate for multi-platform agent management
IP indemnification for IBM Granite models
platforms.best_for: Regulated enterprises prioritizing AI governance, hybrid/on-prem deployment, and agent orchestration across platforms.

platforms.name: Snowflake Cortex AI
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based pricing measured in Snowflake credits per token/function call; no separate model infra to manage.
key_features: Models run inside the Snowflake data perimeter — data never leaves governance boundary
Cortex Analyst and Cortex Search (RAG) over governed data
Role-based access control and masking policies
platforms.best_for: Enterprises whose data already lives in Snowflake and want LLMs applied directly to governed data without movement.

platforms.name: Databricks Mosaic AI / Foundation Model APIs
available_models: Google / OpenAI via external model gateway
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token for foundation model APIs plus provisioned throughput; DBU consumption for training/serving.
key_features: Unity Catalog governance and lineage over data and models
Mosaic AI Model Serving and Gateway
AI Gateway for rate limiting, logging, and credential management
platforms.best_for: Data/ML engineering teams building custom and RAG applications on a lakehouse with strong governance and MLOps.

platforms.name: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Generative AI
platforms.pricing: Per-character/per-token on-demand plus dedicated AI clusters for reserved capacity.
key_features: Dedicated AI clusters for isolated capacity
Fine-tuning (T-Few and full) on dedicated clusters
Integration with Oracle Fusion/Database and sovereign cloud regions
platforms.best_for: Oracle-centric enterprises and sovereign/regulated workloads needing dedicated capacity and tight Oracle app/database integration.

platforms.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-neuron / per-request usage pricing on Cloudflare's global edge network; generous free tier.
key_features: Serverless inference at the network edge (low latency, global)
AI Gateway for caching, rate limiting, logging, and provider failover
Data localization suite for regional residency
Integration with Workers, Vectorize (vector DB), and R2
platforms.best_for: Developers and enterprises wanting low-latency edge inference and a lightweight gateway for open and proxied models.
